summary: WHISPERS: Realms of the Nine is a multiplayer fantasy MMO prototype: its world starts in a character/menu flow and leads into Lantern's Reach, with Briarwild and Emberstone Quarry resource districts. World config provides shared player, camera, arrival and MMORPG UI wiring; place scenes and generator scripts build the environments, while the MMORPG Tools mod owns the menu, character, HUD and interaction systems.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - defaultPlace; 3D decorated menu scene using shared terrain decoration and scripts/look-default.js.
places/character-creation-land/ - 3D character-creation preview scene with off terrain, fixed spawn and creation lighting/effects.
places/main/ - Lantern March playable world; six scene cells hold Lantern's Reach, Briarwild west and Emberstone Quarry east, with gatherable timber/copper and shared heightmap terrain.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach hub buildings, inn, smithy, merchant, bank, cottages, well, quest board, props and lamplit scene pieces.
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene - west forest timber trees tagged gatherable/resource timber.
places/main/cells/x1z0.scene - east quarry copper nodes tagged gatherable/resource copper, plus quarry props.
places/main-menu-land/cells/x0z0.scene and places/character-creation-land/cells/x1z0.scene - authored menu/creation scene objects and fire effects.
design.md and scripts/lib/data/01–05 *.md - creator-facing world/build notes and the fuller design, lore, systems, UX and technical references; not runtime owners.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer world entry; defaults to main-menu-land and binds shared player, custom camera, arrival behavior, MMORPG Tools HUD and nametag.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod.json - mod template/behavior registration; player stack drives menu/character lifecycle and camera stack combines gameplay orbit with creation-camera behavior.
templates/player.js#player - native character body with humanoid locomotion then movement behavior.
templates/camera.js#camera - native custom camera using engine look orientation; currently has no listed behavior itself.
places/main/config.yaml - main's spawn, gravity, cinematic atmosphere, terrain materials/generator and vegetation scatter root.
sim.js - world simulation tick at 1s cadence; currently empty.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ - integrated MMORPG gameplay/UI package: player and character selection, menus, camera, HUD and UI panels, quests, interaction helpers and game data.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - shared race/class/stat, item/shop/quest/music and reusable UI data/rendering modules consumed by mod behaviors and ui.js.
mods/codex/ - creator-facing read-only Codex panel, markdown views and split authored doc pages; its files describe/manage design content, not game runtime state.
mods/aaa-quality-kit/ - visual/audio/UI/model/animation guidance and optional look-cinema.js; main place selects the cinematic look, menu and creation places select scripts/look-default.js.
mods/wow-camera-controls/ - reusable third-person camera control implementation available alongside MMORPG Tools camera behaviors.
scripts/lib/data/player.yml, camera.yml, world.yml - shared movement defaults, camera eye height and terrain base height read by core scripts.
scripts/gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js and spire.js - procedural scene geometry reused by authored place objects with per-instance params/seeds.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, pebble.js and grass-look.js - terrain scatter geometry/material reused by place decoration layers.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - exports onInput, update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - exports sit, onInput, update.
scripts/camera.js - exports finiteNumber, update; scripts/arrival.js - exports onArrive, onLeave; sim.js - exports cadence, tick.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js - exports character/state and place-music helpers, onSpawn, update, onInput, onDisconnect, handleLogout.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/character-select.js - exports race/model preview helpers and onSpawn, update, onInput; main-menu-mgr.js exports roster helpers, onSpawn, update, onInput.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/camera.js - exports camera math and onInput/update; camera-creation.js exports creation phase/input/update behavior.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js - default renderer and menu, zone-banner, WASD and character-creation render helpers; lib/ui-*.js provide individual HUD/menu/quest/inventory/panel renderers.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/quest-giver.js - exports onSpawn, update, onInteract; building-interact.js and interact-prompt.js provide building and nearby-interaction handlers.
mods/codex/lib/codex-ops.js - exports normalized Codex document operations/markdown serializers; codex-doc.js assembles DOC from doc-*.js pages.
ownership: scripts/player.js - transient movement intent in room ctx.session keyed by body; writes character velocity from input and place gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient turn/gait working state; writes character yaw, animation channels and seated locomotion state.
scripts/camera.js - camera rig local-player hiding and eye pose; engine look contract supplies view orientation.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js and character-select.js - MMORPG character/roster lifecycle and character-specific state, preview, persistence and transitions.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/camera.js and camera-creation.js - orbit camera position/input and creation-phase framing; gameplay and creation use different camera modes.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js plus lib/ui-*.js - presentation of player state as HUD, menus, character creation, quest and inventory panels; UI renderer consumes rather than owns gameplay state.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/quest-giver.js - NPC-side quest availability/proximity and dialog handoff; quest data module supplies quest definitions (currently empty database).
scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js + scripts/lib/data/world.yml - terrain height/material; sim.js owns no state yet.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → MMORPG Tools menu behaviors (player.js, character-select.js, main-menu-mgr.js, menu-camera.js) → character creation/main gameplay transitions.
world.config.yaml player template → scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js then scripts/player.js; gait samples body movement before this tick's movement velocity write.
moveX/moveZ/jump input → scripts/player.js onInput stores room-local per-body intent → update eases velocity and applies place gravity; grounded idle bodies sleep.
world.config.yaml camera template and mod camera behavior registration → orbit camera onInput/update; camera-creation.js frames preview while creation phase is active.
engine look orientation → scripts/camera.js reads ctx.self.view → camera rig sets eye position/rotation and hides controlled body locally.
world.config.yaml ui.render → mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js reads world/local player state → lib/ui-* renderers compose HUD, menus and panels; ui/nametag.js renders name tags separately.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/quest-giver.js proximity/interact → reads quest data and player activeQuests → writes showQuestDialog/questDialogData on player → ui.js/lib/ui-quest.js presents it.
places/main/config.yaml terrain.generator → scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js reads world.yml baseHeight; decoration bindings invoke grass/flower/pebble geometry and grass-look material.
places/main/cells/*.scene procedural primitive declarations → scripts/gen/{house,props,tree,rock,spire}.js geometry, varied through params, seeds, tags and transforms.
world.config.yaml lighting → scripts/lighting.js; each place atmosphere chooses its own look script (cinema for main, default for menu and creation).
world.config.yaml engine behavior → scripts/arrival.js onArrive/onLeave lifecycle hooks; both currently empty.
sim.js tick(ctx) runs each second; no current state reads or writes.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js and spire.js - procedural geometry reused across place scene instances, varied by kind/shape params, scale, rotation and seed.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, pebble.js - terrain scatter geometry reused by place bindings, varied by density, scale, seed and item params; grass-look.js separately supplies material.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle behaviors; mod.json registers them on its player/menu template stack.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/camera.js and camera-creation.js - paired gameplay orbit and creation preview camera modes; creation phase suppresses normal orbit input.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-*.js - modular panel renderers composed by ui.js for HUD, menu, quest, inventory, map, character, settings and related screens.
scripts/look-default.js and mods/aaa-quality-kit/look-cinema.js - alternative whole-frame post-process looks selected per place atmosphere.
migrationNotes: Keep movement intent and locomotion scratch in room-local ctx.session, not replicated body state; scripts/player.js writes velocity while place config owns gravity.
templates/player.js runs humanoid-locomotion before player.js; changing behavior order changes which velocity sample drives gait that tick.
Core camera.js uses engine look orientation, places the rig at feetPosition plus eyeHeight × effectiveScale.y, and owns local-player hiding; the MMORPG orbit camera is a separate mod behavior path.
MMORPG Tools camera.js explicitly defers creation-phase handling to camera-creation.js and freezes orbit for open interaction dialogs; preserve these phase/panel guards when changing camera input.
Places use heightmap terrain in main/menu but character-creation-land has terrain off; generator/scatter assumptions are not universal across places.
Codex doc-<tab>.js files are assembled by codex-doc.js and exposed through a read-only panel; codex-ops.js serialization/normalization is shared with authoring, not game runtime.
